findings.title: Opening after an await accepts a changed creation marker because only four marker fields are compared
findings.trigger: After valid append receipt, a separate valid manifest commit changes created-b.sirenNativeCatalogueCreation.requestHash to f*64 while preserving action/projectId/operationId/entityId. Supply the actual new selected schema2 snapshot to service.snapshotFor. Probe at factory await, admission await, and show boundary.
findings.expected: The creation is durably acknowledged, but opening must refuse or return unavailable and must not authorize a newly rebound birth identity. Legitimate later source/metadata edits with the original marker unchanged remain allowed.
findings.actual: All three corrected independent negatives return opening.ok:true and show an admitted working Diagram. Receipt.current still describes pre-mutation revision3 while service sees actual revision4. The append replay layer availability() compares the whole marker; service #available() compares action, projectId, operationId, entityId only.
findings.cause: Marker schema/requestHash/catalogueVersion/referenceSha256/entryId/sourceSha256/entitySha256 are not bound by #available across awaits. This is creation consistency and wrong-identity admission, not a claim that imported metadata alone grants sender authority.
findings.recommendation: Derive or retain a main-owned exact expected birth marker from normalized request, trusted catalogue entry and created UUID; compare the entire marker at every post-await/pre-show/return boundary. Do not expose the birth marker in renderer receipts. Preserve historical birth vs current version separation, and allow same-marker later edits.

staticBudgetAssessment.servicePending: Synchronous #pending>=64 admission and finally decrement bound simultaneous createDiagram invocations through append plus opening; #opening keys are a subset of those held invocations. Existing owner queue/byte budget tests pass.
staticBudgetAssessment.registry: This review does not claim a newly enforced global registry native-window limit. Existing NativeDiagramEdits admission has its own64-working-view guard. No64-concurrent-opening stress/GUI run was performed.
staticBudgetAssessment.callerConcurrency: The same-operation opening promise uses the first caller current closure, so its revocation can legitimately force cleanup/refusal while another caller retries. Own control accepts an authentic second caller success or temporary opening refusal, but requires no private receipt to the revoked caller and no duplicate persisted diagram.
